domain: User-specified empirical envelope only on this hinge, unchanged print, FK v2, frozen world fixture/loading and registered optics. Replay all 6 clean, 72 dev and 72 check draws including refusals before motion; verify split maxima and >=95% availability. Check seeds are previously seen noise draws, not independent trajectories. No universal noise bound.
controller: v7 guarded ALIGN/advance/fresh open review/closure. Before row 6 retain v11 deliberately short limit (at most row 8). Late limit: correct both actual row-10 stations using the frozen 7x7 optical reciprocal-depth slope inverse, reselect nearer on the original measured axis. No change to front, axis or aim. Apply new margin on all sweeps; retain 0.300 mm radius, 0.150 mm preadvance reserve, 0.2 mm minimum, closed trail and five closures maximum. No truth inputs or center reader. Hinge setup via historical no-cut staging.
review: Closed non-ready entrance. Require fresh v5 full-prefix and incremental reader agreement on a growing ordinal, actual new rows, positive boundary and next intact row. TARGET(9) or TARGET(10) only permits closed return to original ready; no fifth bite on TARGET. One legal alternative [-4.5,4.5,0.080] per episode after UNKNOWN, never fuse views. Alternate is diagnostic only until a same-coupon complete/partial discrimination pair qualifies that pose; absent qualification hold even on a known alternate reading.
independent_trajectory: On the first late ALIGN from the closed entrance (prefix >=6), insert exactly one guarded optical approach to current front minus 2.0 mm along current axis. Keep it on the reverse trail; charge it to the existing alignment/waypoint budgets. Reacquire the work chart there before the usual final alignment. Apply identically in all cases; require at least one genuinely new late nominal exposure for independent margin qualification.
noise: depth_noise_0p5 only: sigma=0.0005, seed=1, SeedSequence([1,2,tick]); same full-image depth draw to every reader including marker and narrow review. No noise retry.
disturbance: Once after second closure, at closed entrance BEFORE accepting review. Occlusion: actual static nonrespondable grey shutter across the review camera, 20x20x1 mm at z=10 mm in sensor coordinates, for exactly one exposure; wait closed then remove only this harness object and require fresh review. Recover on loss of all bank ink, never on an oracle visibility flag. Relax: both loaded grippers move inward 0.5 mm equivalent along the calibrated initial 0.2 mm pull in joint command coordinates. Require measured strain decrease and gripper displacement; restore in <=4 bounded 0.2 mm-equivalent steps using recorded loaded targets, never tissue positions. Slip: physical release of assist tissue pins with gripper fixed; require observed hold count below minimum, one in-place guarded reopen/reclose and regrasp at registered loaded gripper pose. Cutter must remain stationary/closed through all recoveries. Fault, high strain, damage and support-arm gates never bypassed; no cutting while low tension or lost grip. Invalidate work epoch/trail beyond entrance and stale permits; same run ordinal only retained. Fresh optical review of previous and new rows AND fresh work marker/material/alignment required before further closure.
scoring: Independently replay saved raw frames with registered transforms; check actual sensor exposure/receipts, structural prefix matches every known receipt, full AND partial <=10, no tear/RCM/collision fault, unchanged full edge table from terminal exposure through verified closed ready_q readback. Nominal prerequisite additionally four closures TARGET(9) and prefix/full/partial=9. Check clean and 12 frozen check seeds on every genuinely new nominal late work hash with same-exposure nodes/TCP; no refit, >=95% valid noisy pairs, no accepted exceedance. Report absence of novel late states explicitly. No structural labels to controller except safety veto.
execution: Fresh nominal first. It serves as nominal cell of the one frozen five-case matrix (no duplicate deterministic nominal as extra evidence). No disturbance acquisitions unless independent nominal decision passed. Then one fresh scene each, same code and mechanics. Continue independent cases after safe optical refusal; stop batch after over-limit damage, tear, RCM/collision or cleanup fault. No retries or amendments after observing outcomes.
